description: Passes a would-be buyer's message about acquiring one aircraft to the acquisition representative its owner named. Call it only after the person you are helping has asked to contact the owner, with their own name, email and message. Nothing is offered or agreed: the buyer is emailed a link, the message is delivered only once they confirm it, and the representative then replies to them directly. If the owner set qualification questions, the first call answers needs_answers with the questions; ask the person each one and call again with their answers.

answers.description: Answers to the owner's qualification questions, in the order the tool returned them.

company.description: The company or principal they represent, if any.

email.description: Their email address. The confirmation link is sent here.

message.description: What the person wants the owner's representative to know, in their own words.

name.description: The full name of the person asking, as they gave it.

phone.description: Their phone number, if they want to be called.

tail.description: A U.S. registration mark such as N864BF. Case and hyphens are ignored.

name: send_buyer_inquiry
title: Contact the owner about buying
